svg.title: FGFormer: architecture, temporal-difference embedding, and Phase-RoPE temporal attention
svg.desc: Top: observed KTH frames, frame and difference embedding plus positional encoding, repeated spatial-temporal-spatial gated transformer blocks, and patch reconstruction. Lower left: independent frame and signed frame-difference projections are added. Lower right: Q and K are rotated by learned per-channel-pair temporal phases, V is unrotated, followed by softmax attention and output projection. Future frames are illustrative source-video frames, not model inference results.
svg.text: T × N × D · N = HW / p²
